Mathverse Quill editor third-party components

Quill 1.3.7
Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/quill/v/1.3.7
License: BSD-3-Clause (see QUILL-LICENSE.txt)

quill-mathlive-blot 1.5.0
Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/quill-mathlive-blot/v/1.5.0
License: GPL-3.0 (see QUILL-MATHLIVE-BLOT-GPL-3.0.txt)
The unminified plugin source included in this package is under
source/quill-mathlive-blot-1.5.0/.

MathLive 0.55.0 (dependency of quill-mathlive-blot)
Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/mathlive/v/0.55.0
License: MIT (see MATHLIVE-0.55-LICENSE.txt)

The Mathverse compatibility adapter source is included at
source/quill-editor-entry.js. The browser bundle is produced with esbuild
using the dependency versions above.
